description: This file implements a static class FontFamilyCache within the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, responsible for caching and retrieving font family objects by name, including functions for cache management and state reporting.

classes.name: FontFamilyCache
classes.description: Static class managing a cache of internal font family objects, providing methods to retrieve, cache, reset, and display cache state.

methods.name: GetFamilyByName
methods.description: Retrieves a font family from cache by name, returning null if not found.

methods.name: CacheOrGetFontFamily
methods.description: Caches a given FontFamilyInternal object or returns an existing one with the same name.

methods.name: GetCacheState
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current font family cache state.
